r4b-001.gate_key:
rep_questions | B1.2 | order | 'When does the bus usually come?'
Put the words in order. | she asked me when the bus usually came

key.sentence: she asked me when the bus usually came

item.q:
'When does the bus usually come?'
Put the words in order.
item.why: In a reported question the word order is like a statement: subject + verb (*where I lived*), with no *do / does / did*, and the verb goes one step back.
item.why_lv: Atstāstītā jautājumā vārdu secība ir kā apgalvojumā: teikuma priekšmets + darbības vārds (*where I lived*), bez *do / does / did*, un laiks pāriet vienu soli atpakaļ.
item.sentence: she asked me when the bus usually came
answers: she asked me when the bus usually came
